why: T50: DMPNNBondHead was the only bond head without metal_set/donor_zs, and its is_dative rule was frozen at the pre-Wf-A69 Pt-only one-directional form. Records what the old rule produced per pair and what the shared rule produces now.
choice: (a) unify — add the two attributes and the symmetric rule; keep the 3-column edge feature
why_a_not_b: the kill condition for (a) was 'does it change the pair_head input width'. It does not: the edge features stay [d, is_dative, is_short] = 3 columns, and metal_set/donor_zs only change HOW is_dative is computed. So the head can carry the extended rule, and deleting the branch would have thrown away a working architecture over an attribute that was simply missing.
code_change: molmetal/scripts/train_cfm_yuelbond_wasserstein.py DMPNNBondHead.__init__: metal_set / donor_zs kwargs, defaulting to _DEFAULT_METAL_SET / _DONOR_ZS
DMPNNBondHead.forward: symmetric isin(donor) x isin(metal) rule, same as YuelBondDecoderHead (Wf-A69 W2 / Wf-A92)

measurement.method: the head returns logits, not edge features, so the test rewires pair_head to pass the is_dative channel through: first layer zeroed except the is_dative input column, output layer zeroed except one class. That class's logit is then exactly the flag the head computed.
measurement.metal_index_note: the metal is placed at index 1 in every pair, i.e. the HIGHER index, because triu_indices stores pairs as (i<j) and the old rule tested the donor on z_i. Pt-Cl fails the old rule for that reason alone, which is the direction half of the bug.

metal_set_override.why: proves the rule reads the attribute rather than a constant

regression_guard: restoring the old expression fails 5 tests (the four dative pairs plus the metal_set override); verified by temporarily reverting the rule
latency: no YAML in configs/ sets bond_predictor: dmpnn, so this head is unreachable from a launch. Latent, not harmless: the CLI accepts the value, so the next caller would get a Pt-only feature and an AttributeError at checkpoint time.
honest_limits: No run was executed with this head. The evidence is the per-pair flag on synthetic diatomic clouds plus the attribute surface; nothing here shows the head trains or that its logits improve.

The 3-column edge feature is unchanged, so this is a correctness fix to an input, not an architecture change — but it does mean any future dmpnn checkpoint would be fitted under a DIFFERENT is_dative definition than any existing one, which is why the feature schema is stamped.
